The packaging for this product has changed. You may receive this item in either the previous packaging or new packaging. There is no change to the product formulation.

Quick-curing, acetoxy silicone for a permanent watertight, flexible seal. Good adhesion properties, suitable for sealing glass, aluminium, painted surfaces, sanitaryware, ceramics and non-porous surfaces. Weatherproof, anti-fungal and UV-resistant.
